mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in the federal funds rate over three consecutive months signals a tightening monetary policy stance, raising discount rates and reducing present value of future corporate earnings, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises for three consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -0.05 z-score) during periods when FEDFUNDS rises for three consecutive months in at least 80% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters indicates weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate revenue growth and depresses equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the subsequent 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 falls for two consecutive quarters
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -0.10 z-score) during periods when GDPC1 declines for two consecutive quarters.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate above 8% within a single month signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which reduces consumer spending and corporate profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE crosses above 8% in one month
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -0.05 z-score) when UNRATE exceeds 8% in a single month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained contraction in industrial production (INDPRO) below its 12-month moving average for six consecutive months indicates persistent supply-side weakness, which erodes earnings and capital expenditure, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < 12-month MA for six consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -0.10 z-score) during periods when INDPRO remains below its 12-month MA for six consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL above their respective 12-month averages signals a monetary tightening accompanied by accelerating inflation, which increases real interest rates and compresses equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL both exceed 12-month averages
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -0.05 z-score) when both FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL exceed their 12-month averages simultaneously.

mechanism_narrative: A coordinated surge in both personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) above their 12-month moving averages for three consecutive months signals a robust demand recovery, which boosts earnings expectations and equity valuations, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 and HOUST both exceed 12-month MA for three consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (> +0.05 z-score) when both GDPC1 and HOUST exceed their 12-month MA for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) above 200k for eight consecutive months signals robust labor market expansion, which supports consumer spending and corporate profitability, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (> +0.10 z-score) during periods when PAYEMS exceeds 200,000 for eight consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Real personal savings (RSAFS) falling below its 10-year average while personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) rise above their 10-year average signals a shift from saving to spending, which amplifies aggregate demand and supports equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (> +0.05 z-score) when RSAFS is below its 10-year average and GDPC1 is above its 10-year average.
